template<typename F, typename S>
class Pair {
public:
    F first;
    S second;
    Pair(F f, S s) : first(f), second(s) {}
};

class PairComp {
public:
    int operator()(const Pair<int, int>& p1, const Pair<int, int>& p2) {
        return compare(p1.first, p2.first);
    }
private:
    int compare(int a, int b) {
        if (a < b) return -1;
        if (a > b) return 1;
        return 0;
    }

int modAdd(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (int)(((ll)(a % mod) + (b % mod)) % mod);
}

int modSub(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (int)(((ll)(a % mod) - (b % mod) + mod) % mod);
}

int modMul(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (int)(((ll)(a % mod) * (b % mod)) % mod);
}

int modPow(int base, int exp, int mod) {
    int res = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = modMul(res, base, mod);
        base = modMul(base, base, mod);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int modDiv(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return modMul(a, modPow(b, mod - 2, mod), mod);
}

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    while (b != 0) { int t = b; b = a % b; a = t; }
    return a;
}

int lowerBound(vector<int>& arr, int val) {
    int lo = 0, hi = (int)arr.size() - 1, ans = -1;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        if (arr[mid] < val) { ans = mid; lo = mid + 1; }
        else hi = mid - 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

vector<ll> logSeries(ll limit, ll target) {
    ll i = 1, sum = 0;
    int cnt = 0;
    vector<ll> res(2);
    while (i < limit) {
        sum += i;
        cnt++;
        if (sum == target) { res[0] = cnt; res[1] = sum; return res; }
        i *= 2;
    }
    res[0] = cnt; res[1] = sum;
    return res;
}

void addCount(map<int, int>& map, int key) {
    map[key] = map[key] + 1;
}

ll listSum(vector<ll>& list) {
    ll total = 0;
    for (ll x : list) total += x;
    return total;
}

int charIndex(char c) { return c - 'a'; }

int optimizedSearch(vector<int>& prefix, int start, int target, int n) {
    int lo = start + 1, hi = n - 1, ans = start;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        int diff = prefix[mid] - prefix[start];
        if (diff == target) return mid;
        if (diff < target) { ans = mid; lo = mid + 1; }
        else hi = mid - 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

Pair<ll, int> computeStats(vector<int>& list) {
    ll total = 0;
    int minVal = INT_MAX;
    for (int x : list) {
        total += x;
        minVal = min(minVal, x);
    }
    return Pair<ll, int>(total - minVal, minVal);
}

int maxDivisor(map<int, int>& map, int num, int req) {
    int maxK = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i * i <= num; i++) {
        if (num % i == 0) {
            int d1 = i, d2 = num / i;
            addCount(map, d1);
            if (d1 != d2) addCount(map, d2);
            if (map[d1] == req) maxK = max(maxK, d1);
            if (map[d2] == req) maxK = max(maxK, d2);
        }
    }
    return maxK;
}

vector<int> extractKeys(map<int, int>& map) {
    vector<int> keys;
    for (auto& p : map) keys.push_back(p.first);
    return keys;
}

vector<int> extractValues(map<int, int>& map) {
    vector<int> values;
    for (auto& p : map) values.push_back(p.second);
    return values;
}

int arrayMax(vector<int>& list) {
    if (list.empty()) return 0;
    return *max_element(list.begin(), list.end());
}

int arrayMin(vector<int>& list) {
    if (list.empty()) return 0;
    return *min_element(list.begin(), list.end());
}

const int MOVES[4][2] = {{-1,0},{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1}};

int main() {
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    int n = s.length();
    int ways = 0;

    if (n == 1) {
        char c = s[0];
        ways = (c == '0' || c == '_' || c == 'X') ? 1 : 0;
    } else if (s[0] == '0') {
        ways = 0;
    } else {
        vector<string> validEnds = {"25", "50", "75", "00"};
        vector<string> wildEnds = {"__", "_X", "X_", "XX"};
        string tail = s.substr(n - 2);
        char c0 = tail[0], c1 = tail[1];

        if (c0 == 'X' && c1 == 'X' && s[0] == 'X') {
            ways = 0;
        } else {
            for (const string& end : validEnds) {
                if (tail == end) { ways = 1; break; }
            }

            if (ways == 0) {
                if (c0 == '_' || c0 == 'X') {
                    ways = 2;
                    if (c1 == '0' && s[0] == 'X') ways = 1;
                } else if (c1 == '_' || c1 == 'X') {
                    ways = 1;
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    if (tail == wildEnds[i]) {
                        if (i == 0) ways = (n == 2) ? 3 : 4;
                        else if (i == 1) ways = (s[0] == 'X') ? 2 : 4;
                        else if (i == 2) ways = (s[0] == 'X') ? 3 : 4;
                        else if (i == 3) ways = 1;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (c0 != '2' && c0 != '5' && c0 != '7' && c0 != '0' && c0 != 'X' && c0 != '_') ways = 0;
            if (c1 != '0' && c1 != '5' && c1 != 'X' && c1 != '_') ways = 0;

            ll multiplier = 1;
            bool hasX = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {
                if (s[i] == 'X') hasX = true;
                if (s[i] == '_') multiplier *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
            }

            if (c0 != 'X' && c1 != 'X') {
                if (hasX) multiplier *= (s[0] == 'X') ? 9 : 10;
            }

            ways = max(ways, 0);
            multiplier *= ways;
            ways = (int)multiplier;
        }
    }

    cout << ways << endl;
    return 0;
}
